entries.english: This outfit was inspired by a festival in a distant land. They say revelers dress up and parade from door to door, asking each household to hand out treats or face a prank. The ghosts decorating the outfit make it feel all the more festive.

Dances, temporarily granting you a moderate increase to damage dealt.
Lets out a loud bleat, temporarily granting you a moderate increase to movement speed.
Grooms itself, temporarily reducing the damage you take by a moderate amount.

Whatever I do next, being a registered adventurer would make life easier.
First I'll have to pass the exam. Then I can make it official.

I caught Aeryn and Tyris talking about something intriguing.
There's so much I don't know about these two who say they're from the future. Maybe I'll get a glimpse of what they've been keeping to themselves.

We didn't set out to help the Dragon Tribe, but now that we have, we can move freely through their territory.
They haven't exactly warmed to us, but they're willing to talk.
Let's use this chance to find out where Voldigen is.
Granville Ice World　Go to the source of the signal the Omnistron picked up.

Granville Ice World　Head to Valmlant.
Granville Ice World　Go to the square where the children are raised.
Granville Ice World　Speak to members of the Dragon Tribe.

Granville Ice World　Find the woman of the Dragon Tribe with a child in her care.

◇　　　　　◇　　　　　◇　　　　　◇

We've reached Valmlant, a settlement of the Dragon Tribe.
Wreckage littered the entrance. A recent attack by Bapharian weapons had left fresh scars.
Even here, Bapharian weapons are a threat.
Urugarm says he's going to show us the children of the Dragon Tribe.
He says the woman we helped earlier is in the square.

◇　　　　　◇　　　　　◇　　　　　◇

People in the Dragon Tribe have minds of their own.
Some may have little respect for Voldigen or feel no need to obey him.
If we ask around, someone might tell us where to find Voldigen and the Avaritia Shell.
Let's strike up a conversation, work Voldigen's name into it, and see how they react.

◇　　　　　◇　　　　　◇　　　　　◇

Doren seemed to feel a little better once we gave him some engram crystals.
We left the rest with him in the hope that they'd be of use to Valmlant.
Doren looked at us with suspicion, but Aeryn smiled. “I just couldn’t leave someone to suffer.”

I'm Like. I brew magic potions. Hee hee hee.
I need a few ingredients for a new potion. You don't think I'd ask you to fetch anything suspicious, do you?
I'm counting on you. Hee hee hee hee hee...
A Man, a Woman, and a Potion
A Civil Servant Caught in the Middle

I'm Aleni. I cook for a living.
Whenever I season a dish, it comes out fiery hot. My customers tell me it's delicious, even as they scream and cry.
But one customer came in the other day who didn't seem to feel the heat at all. I couldn't quite read the look on their face.
I've never met anyone like that before. I keep thinking about them.
Adventurer, would you help me find that customer?
A Knight Carved with Soul and Pride
I Think This One Will Sell!

I'm Amado, a merchant... Well, merchant-in-training is more like it.
There's a lot to get ready before I can set up shop.
There's a plant I'd like to make my big seller. Trouble is, I hear there are monsters where it grows.
Could you find out what monsters are out there and clear them out for me?
I'll make it worth your while!
Can't expect to hit it big someday if I'm not willing to spend a little now!
By the Soft Glow of Flowers
The Truth About Good Luck Charms
I Think I've Finally Got a Hit!
The Little Knights on the Road
In Search of a Nameless Voice

It's me, Anne! Genius inventor and future merchant magnate!
I'm due to dream up a bestseller any day now.
This time I've got it! Luxury down comforters!
And I've thought of everything. I'm going to sell the kids on them!
Oh, these'll sell all right. I'll be rolling in money!
There's a share in it for you too, adventurer, so bring me some top-notch materials!

I'm Maulili, an apothecary.
I think there's an illness going around. Every so often I come across someone having a coughing fit.
I'd like to get some medicine ready now, while there's time.
When an illness starts to spread, it pays to act fast.
I'll see to making the medicine. Could you gather the ingredients at Ia More Reef for me?
The Weight of All Those Years
The Baron Wants His Caravans Safe
The Right to Tread on Sacred Ground
A Costume to Dance in the Sea
A New Pattern for an Old Tradition
Let the Forest Sleep in Peace
The Glow of Hours Gone By

I'm Totohoala!
Adventurer, will you chase the monsters out of the Silent Forest?
It's a kind of boar called the Soiree Tyrant Boar. We've had it up to here with them!
So many of our ancestors are buried in the Silent Forest, and those boars tear through there day after day. They won't even let the dead rest!
I can't stand it! Please, do something about them, and soon!
The Great Beast That Eats Snow
A Future for the Snow Flowers
Secret of Defense: Ranged Attacks G5
Secret of Defense: Melee Attacks G5
Violet Lightning Bow of the Keen Eye
Staff of a Thousand Scorching Bolts
